vo_face_round_full_perimeter.evidence: At thumbnail scale, both temple-to-cheek edges, both jaw arcs, and the chin form one uninterrupted readable perimeter; pulled-back hair does not cover either side.

vo_face_round_vertical_relation.evidence: At thumbnail and native scales, the hairline-to-chin span stays close to the cheek-to-cheek span, so the face reads compact rather than oval or oblong.

vo_face_round_cheek_width.evidence: At thumbnail and native scales, broad lateral cheek presence remains visible across the mid-face and materially participates in the complete outer contour.

vo_face_round_lower_curve.evidence: At native scale, each mandibular side follows a soft continuous curve into a short rounded chin; no angular corner or isolated pointed tip is visible.

vo_face_round_confound_control.evidence: At native scale, the mouth is neutral, hair is pulled away, contour makeup does not carry the edge, and moderate portrait perspective shows no near-lens center enlargement; the global outline itself carries the result.
